checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Large shocked human face on right
must.why: Big face, wide eyes, open mouth, hands on cheeks, headset.

must.item: Headline reads exactly ONE LAST TRY, no extra words
must.why: Three lines, correct spelling, no other text.

must.item: Headline on left, high contrast, not covering face
must.why: Yellow with black outline on blue; it sits close to the face but does not cover it.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px) and slight softness; the headline sits close to the face.

summary: A bright, punchy thumbnail with correctly spelled yellow "ONE LAST TRY" on the left and a shocked headset gamer on the right; only the low resolution is a minor issue.
